settings.title: A new dawn is breaking in the breakfast aisle.
settings.content:
Oatmeal has always been a trusted staple of our mornings and in our training. That’s why we made it our mission to create a new champion of breakfast. 

The result of our work is DAWNBREAKER PROTEIN OATMEAL. Made to meet the needs of people like us who have high standards when it comes to clean ingredients and functional macros, this isn’t the breakfast of yesterday, or even the breakfast of tomorrow. This is a breakfast for today, and we’re amped for you to try it.
